reason: My broker already puts the same amount into index funds every month for free, and I barely look at it. A pet agent that rebalances and pays for things is a fun demo, but it fixes a problem I don't have, and I'm not paying a subscription to invest.
objection: A monthly fee on top of cheap index funds costs more than the funds' own expense ratios, and I'd be giving an AI agent from a new app access to real money through a broker partner that isn't even named yet.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or cost about what my broker charges, with a named, regulated broker holding the money, and it showed me it actually beat my set-and-forget plan after fees.
